_annotation.name: How It Works / Process Steps
_annotation.what: 4-step process showing how a customer engages — contact, evaluation, proposal, execution. Shows how your service delivery works.
_annotation.why: Complexity kills conversions. If a visitor can't immediately understand 'how this works,' they'll leave. Clear steps remove friction and make starting feel effortless.
_annotation.ai_popolates: Step titles and descriptions: Generated to match your service type. Copy is customized per industry.
_annotation.your_input: Confirm your service delivery model (consultation → proposal → execution or self-service). We adjust the process steps accordingly.

title: Contact us
desc: Write to us via WhatsApp or fill out the form. We respond in less than 24 hours.

title: We evaluate your situation
desc: First free session to understand your business, your challenges and your goals.

title: We propose a plan
desc: We build a personalized solution according to your needs and budget.

title: We start working
desc: We execute the plan together, with constant support and adjustments as we progress.
